lines.t: Make the way straight, make the way straight, make it straight for His return
The earth trembles, the King is coming
Thus says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand, power to birth
In my left hand, judgment and flame
I am he, the engine of days, the great I am
The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
Whose name is Israel, none can shake him
I set my only begotten, the work became flesh
Yahushua, Emmanuel, righteousness in breath
He came once in mercy, he comes again in power
Every knee will bow, every nation will cower
The Holy One returns, the trumpet sounds
Oh, the Lord of hosts is heaven bound
Make the way straight
Prepare His path, don't wait Yahushua HaMashiach, the lion will roar
Call His name, be restored The Lord comes now, make the way straight
Ahead came John, the voice in the wild Crying out repent, the spirit compiled
pile trumpet in hand water and word baptized the broken spoke what he heard now 144,000 rise in the
land fire in their voices trumpet in hand spirit of elijah thunder in their breath preparing the
way defying death witnesses walking with tongues of flame bearing his name not seeking fame
judgments fall foundations quake the pride of man the lord shall break cities fall towers
Desolation sweeps, yet there's hope in the end
Call upon Yahushua, call and be saved
The Lamb who conquered the grave
Yet there's sanctuary in the storm
A way of escape has been formed
He is the Christ, Yahushua by name
Call upon Him, be free from shame
Make the way straight
Repent and rise
Don't wait, don't wait
Trumpet sound
Hearts ignite
Y'all sure reign
Forever in life
Call upon Him in truth
And you shall surely be delivered
Says the Lord
Thanks for watching!
